scope: Company physical cash accounting before existing merchant payout continues
features: Independent company cashbox workspace and registered staff custodians
Documented one-time opening with live approval limits and independent review by default
Receipts, expenses and atomic inter-cashbox transfers with balanced journal lines
Physical count, unresolved variance lock, independently approved shortage/overage adjustment or reasoned count void
Counted custody handover, including supervised recovery from suspended custodian
One-time linked reversal without deleting original evidence
Immutable hashed ledger and current complete source balance; paginated 25-row histories and CSV
Company printable current balance and explicitly loaded-scope movements/counts, signatures and issue time
Server-issued merchant cash voucher debits physical asset atomically once; final merchant receipt/reconciliation uses clearing instead of debiting cash again
notIncluded: No automatic bank or Zain Cash transfer integration
No real cash delivery or cash funding by agent
Not a complete company ERP or automatic import of all outside cash movements
security: Verified staff session and live permissions, scope, approval cap, explicit existing staging operator policy only
Owner sessions cannot administer company cash
Pinned source/custody/balance snapshots and transactional guards
Stable request identity and proof reuse protection
No new IAM permissions; existing bounded cash prefixes verified
nextUserStep: Refresh Finance, open Company Cashboxes, register a company source and assign a registered staff custodian; then document and approve its actual/test opening before existing cash payout.
